αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also with other neut. nouns (αἰπὺ πτολίεθρον ’steep citadel’)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
αὐτολύκου: Αὐτόλυκος — Autolycus, father of Anticleia; masc. gen. sg.
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
αὐτόλυκος: Αὐτόλυκος — Autolycus, Odysseus’ maternal grandfather, a master thief; masc. nom. sg.
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’ · also fem. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὴ δὲ χθαμαλὴ κεῖται ’and the island itself lies low’) · also intensive, 1st person: ’I myself’ (οἶδα καὶ αὐτή ’I know it myself’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also masc. gen. pl., ’their own’ with no possessive expressed (αὐτῶν κτήματα ’their own possessions’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βάν: βαίνω — step, go, set out; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
βαθυρρόου: βαθύρροος — deep-flowing; masc. gen. sg., epithet of Ocean
βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
γαμβρὸς: γαμβρός — son-in-law, relative by marriage; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γρηῢς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς)
γυναιξὶν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ξιν (ν-movable), grave mid-clause form
γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
δέρον: δέρω — flay, skin; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδερον)
δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’ · also gen. after δεύομαι ’lack’: ’lacking the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης) · also gen. sg. depending on a noun: ’of the feast’ (δαιτὸς ἀνίην ’the vexation of the feast’) · also gen. sg. after ὄνησο (ὀνίνημι mid.): δαιτὸς ὄνησο ’have enjoyment of the feast’
δακρυόφι: δάκρυ — tear; instrumental in -φι, epic: ’with tears’
δαμάσῃ: δάμνημι/δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fearing with μή
δεξιτερῆφι: δεξιτερός — right, on the right; fem. dat. sg. with the suffix -φι (= Attic δεξιᾷ): ’in the right (hand)’
δεξιὸν: δεξιός — right, on the right hand; masc. acc. sg.
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’)
διέχευαν: διαχέω — pour apart, cut up (a carcass); aor. 3 pl.: ’they cut her apart’
διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
δμῳὰς: δμῳή — female slave, servant-woman; fem. acc. pl., epic (cf. Attic δούλη)
δολιχὸν: δολιχός — long; masc. acc. sg. (δολιχὸν πλόον ’a long voyage’)
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: δόρυ χάλκεον ... εἰρυσάμην ’I drew out the bronze spear’
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰκοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; ordinal adj., masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἤματι εἰκοστῷ ’on the twentieth day’)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εὐρύκλεια: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’
θήρην: θήρα — hunting, quarry, catch; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic θήραν)
θαλερὴ: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, full; fem. nom. sg., epithet of the voice or of tears · also of fat: ’abundant’ (θαλερὴ ἀλοιφή)
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’ · also nom. sg. in apposition to a name following: θεὸς … Ἑρμείας ’a god, Hermes’
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented, in tmesis (κατά … ἔδυ = κατέδυ): ’went down into’ · also without tmesis, of the sun: ’set, went down’ (ἠέλιος κατέδυ)
κατέλεξεν: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. 3 sg.: ’recounted, told in full’
καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’at the sun’s going down, at sunset’)
καταειμένον: καθέννυμι — clothe, cover; perf. mid./pass. part. neut. nom. sg. (καταείμενος) ’clothed in’, with dat.
καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν)
κελαινὸν: κελαινός — dark, black; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’)
κνέφας: κνέφας — dusk, darkness, nightfall; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
κτήματ: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. acc. pl., elided (κτήματ’ = κτήματα)
κτύπος: κτύπος — crash, thud, din; masc. nom. sg.
κὰδ: κατά (apocope κάδ before δ-) — down through, throughout; prep./preverb in tmesis: ’throughout the halls’ (κὰδ δώματα = κατὰ δώματα) · also a bare preverb in tmesis with a verb: κὰδ ... ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε ’threw down’
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
λέβητι: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. dat. sg.
λίθος: λίθος — stone, rock; masc. nom. sg.
λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken (me in)’
λευκῷ: λευκός — white, bright, clear; neut. dat. sg. (ὕδατι λευκῷ ’with bright water’) · also masc. dat. sg., instrumental, agreeing with ὀδόντι: ’with a white tusk’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’) · also neut. nom. sg. in the periphrasis ἱερὸν μένος Ἀλκινόοιο: ’the sacred strength of Alcinous’, a periphrasis for Alcinous himself
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they cut into small pieces’
μακών: μηκάομαι — bleat, cry out (of animals); aor. part. masc. nom. sg., strong aor. ἔμακον: ’crying out’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεμαώς: μέμονα (defective perf., pres. force) — be eager, be minded; perf. part. μεμαώς, masc. nom. sg.: ’eager’, + inf.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοίρας: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. acc. pl.
μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μυθήσεαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, relate; fut. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted (= Attic μυθήσῃ)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴν: μήν — truly, indeed; affirmative particle; καὶ μὴν ’and moreover, and further’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt) · also adv., ’just now, a moment ago’ (νέον ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’just now than before’; νέον ἦσθα γέρων ’just now you were an old man’)
νηλείτιδές: νηλείτις — guiltless, blameless; fem. nom. pl. (accented νηλείτιδές before the enclitic εἰσιν)
νοστήσαντι: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to you having come home’ · also ’(to him) who has come home’ (τῷ … οἴκαδε νοστήσαντι, of the man who has heard the Sirens)
νοῆσαι: νοέω — perceive, notice, take note of; aor. inf.: ’to glimpse, to notice’ · also ’think out, think of’ (πεπνυμένα πάντα νοῆσαι ’to think of all prudent things’)
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τὸν Τηλεφίδην: ’what a man, such a one as’ (ἀλλ’ οἷον … κατενήρατο ’but what a man he slew’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of such a kind as’ (οἷον ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ἄγησι ’such as the day he brings’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐλὴν: οὐλή — scar, healed wound; fem. acc. sg. (grave accent mid-clause; not οὖλος ’thick, woolly’)
οὐτάμεναι: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. inf. act., epic -μεναι (= Attic οὐτάσαι)
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to suffer’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πέσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσε)
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. gen. sg. (φίλης ... παιδός ’a dear daughter’) · also masc. gen. sg., ’son’ (παιδὸς ἐμοῖο ’my son’; τοῦ παιδὸς ἀγαυοῦ ’the noble son’)
παρνησόνδ: Παρνησός (Attic Παρνασσός) — Parnassus; with the suffix -δε of direction, elided (Παρνησόνδ’ = Παρνησόνδε): ’to Parnassus’
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πενταέτηρον: πενταέτηρος — five years old; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὗν
περάασκε: περάω — pass through; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -ασκε, marking repeated/habitual past action: ’used to pass through’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’
περιφραδέως: περιφραδέως — very thoughtfully, carefully (adv. of περιφραδής)
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
πηνελόπειαν: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; acc. sg.
πλῆσθεν: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic apocopated ending -θεν (= -θησαν): ’were filled’
ποδοῖϊν: πούς — foot; gen. dual, epic -οῖϊν (= Attic ποδοῖν): ’of the two feet’
πολλή: πολύς — much, many; adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
πολλοῖσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic πολλοῖς): ’for many’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
πολυάρητος: πολυάρητος — much prayed to (or much prayed for); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θεός
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρόπαν: πρόπας — all through, the whole; neut. acc. sg., of time (πρόπαν ἦμαρ ’all day long’)
πρώτιστος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., epic double superlative πρώτιστος: ’the very first’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
πρὸ: πρό — before, in front; prep. + gen.; also adv. or preverb in tmesis, ’ahead, forward’ (πρὸ … ἔαξεν ’broke ahead’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πόδα: πούς — foot; also the sheet (the rope that sets a sail); masc. acc. sg.
πόροι: πόρον (πορεῖν) — give, furnish; aor. opt. 3 sg. (a defective aorist with no present in this sense)
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πύθηται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. subj. 3 sg., purpose clause: ’so that he may learn’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σίγα: σιγάω — be silent; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be quiet!’
σίδηρος: σίδηρος — iron; masc. nom. sg., hence weapon of iron
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in silence’
σοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφίσιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς), reflexive of the subject: ’for themselves’ · also dat. pl. after μετά, not reflexive: ’among them’ (μετὰ σφίσιν)
σχεδόθεν: σχεδόθεν — from near, close at hand; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. (φίλον τέκος ’dear child’)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίη: τίη — why?; interrog. adv., epic (= Attic τί)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also periphrastic with the pres. ἐστίν rather than fut. ἔσται, of a thing already fixed by fate: ’it is a thing ordained, it is decreed’ · also periphrastic with the opt. εἴη, in a wish: ’may it be fulfilled’ (τετελεσμένον εἴη)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι) · also τοι, the affirming particle, accented τοί before an enclitic: ἀλλ’ ἦ τοί σε ’but truly you’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τυχὼν: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain, + gen.; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having obtained’
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the swine · also fem. acc. pl. with ἄλλας, article-like: ’the others’ (τὰς δ’ ἄλλας ’and the other (portions)’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον · also nom. dual with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … θεράποντε)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
υἱάσιν: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ-, ν-movable (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
υἱέες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάεα: φάος — light; pl. ’eyes’ (lights); neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶτα)
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φάρυγος: φάρυγξ — throat, gullet; fem. gen. sg.
φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’ · also pass. inf., ’to be carried’ (by the wind): Βορέῃ προβάλεσκε φέρεσθαι ’would toss it to the North Wind to be carried’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φίλου: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. sg.
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φαέθων: φαέθω — shine, blaze; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
φαεινοῦ: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. gen. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg. · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (γέγηθε φρένα ’is glad in heart’)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωτός: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. sg.
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing
χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, instrumental: ’with your hands’
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.
χρή: χρή — there is need (of); impersonal verb, + acc. of person and gen. of thing
χύσις: χύσις — a pouring, a heap; fem. nom. sg.
ἀέντων: ἄημι — blow; pres. part. gen. pl. masc., agreeing with ἀνέμων: ’of winds blowing’
ἀγαυούς: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. acc. pl.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀθρῆσαι: ἀθρέω — look at, catch sight of; aor. inf. act., complementary with δυνάμην
ἀκτῖσιν: ἀκτίς — ray (of the sun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι(ν)
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about, on both sides of; prep. + acc. · also preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφί … ἕπον = ἀμφέπον ’busied themselves about, dressed’)
ἀμφαφάασθαι: ἀμφαφάομαι — feel all over, handle; pres. inf., epic -άασθαι (= Attic -ᾶσθαι)
ἀμφεπένοντο: ἀμφιπένομαι — busy oneself about, attend to; impf. mid. 3 pl., augmented
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); gen. sg.
ἀνασχόμενος: ἀνέχω — hold up; mid. raise oneself, lift up one’s arm; aor. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
ἀντιθέοιο: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀπαμείβετο: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἀπημείβετο)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀποπέμψω: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off, dismiss; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will send away’ · also aor. subj. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that I may send off’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρούρας: ἄρουρα — ploughland, field; fem. acc. pl.
ἀτιμάζουσι: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀτιμάζουσιν), + acc.
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἁψαμένη: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. fasten on, attach; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having fastened’
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’)
ἄκουσαν: ἀκούω — hear, heed; aor. 3 pl., + gen. of the person heard: ’heeded him’
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλγος: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom. sg.
ἄλλας: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. acc. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’ · also in apposition to a plural subject: ’both of us’ (ἱκόμεθ’ ἄμφω)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄρσενα: ἄρσην — male; neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’the males’ (Attic ἄρρην, ἄρρενα)
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat. · also ἅμα … τε, correlative: ’both … and’ (ἅμα τ’ αὐτῆς Πηνελοπείης … καὶ σέθεν εἵνεκα ’both for Penelope herself and for your sake’)
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐΐσης: ἐΐσος — equal, balanced, well-proportioned (of a ship; sense debated); fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἴσος) · also fem. gen. sg. agreeing with δαιτός: ’equal, fair-shared’ (δαιτὸς ἐΐσης)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’ · also accented before the elided enclitic ποτ’ (ποτέ): ἐγώ ποτ’ ’I once’ · also accented before the enclitic περ: ὅσσα τ’ ἐγώ περ ’as much as I’
ἐδεύετο: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was lacking’
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
ἐλθόντα: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having come, on his coming’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
ἐμόν: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form; agrees with τέκνον) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: οἶκον ἐμόν ’my house’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνέην: ἔνειμι — be in, be therein; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐνῆν): ’(wine) was in (them)’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξερέεινον: ἐξερεείνω — question closely, ask about; impf. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (cf. Attic ἐξερωτάω)
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐπιμασσάμενος: ἐπιμαίομαι — feel over, grope at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having felt out’
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐπώνυμον: ἐπώνυμος — named, bearing a name (whether it fits or means anything is uncertain); neut. nom. sg., in apposition to ὄνομα
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσέδρακεν: εἰσδέρκομαι — look at, behold; aor. 3 sg., epic (= εἰσέδρακεν): ’saw’
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with θύρετρα ’doors’: καὶ εὐρέα περ ἐόντα ’wide though they are’
ἑκάστην: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. acc. sg.
ἑτέρῃ: ἕτερος — the other (of two); fem. dat. sg., often with χειρί understood: ’with the other (hand)’
ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’
ἔλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤλασεν)
ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may come’
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’) · also doubled, ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’this way and that’
ἔπεσ: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔπεσ’ = ἔπεσε): ’fell’
ἔπεσσί: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔπτατο: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐπτάτο): ’flew’
ἔσσυτ: σεύομαι — rush, hasten; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, elided (ἔσσυτ’ = ἔσσυτο)
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
ἔσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι (aor. mid. of ἔχω; in tmesis ὑπὸ ... ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο) — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’promised’ · also ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold, check; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’was checked’ (θαλερὴ ἔσχετο φωνή) · also ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; aor. mid. 3 sg., reflexive: ’held himself back’ (φρεσὶ δ’ ἔσχετο ’he checked himself in his mind’)
ἔτεϊ: ἔτος — year; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἔτει)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’ · also adjectival, with a noun: ’each piece’ (ὅπλα ἕκαστα) · also neut. nom. pl. in apposition: ’each’ (πεντήκοντα δ’ ἕκαστα ’fifty to each’)
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἕπον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend, dress (meat); impf. 3 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (= ἀμφέπον)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; nom. sg. · also Ἠέλιος, the Sun as a god, Helios: nom. sg.
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠνεμοέσσας: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept; fem. acc. pl. of ἠνεμόεσσα (epic -όεσσα for -όεις)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠσπάζοντο: ἀσπάζομαι — greet, welcome; impf. 3 pl., augmented
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’ · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they came’
ἤϊεν: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’he came, he returned’
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι)
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀδόντι: ὀδούς (Ionic ὀδών) — tooth, tusk; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a tusk’
ὀλέσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. inf. act. (= Attic ἀπολέσαι): ’to destroy’
ὀτρύνοντος: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive with ἄκουσαν: ’heeded him urging’
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., ’a mountain’, subject of a verbless clause naming it: ἐν δ’ ὄρος αὐτῇ ’and on it a mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἐστιν: ’(this) is the mountain’ (Νήριτόν ἐστιν ὄρος)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι) · also with a superlative, ’as … as possible’ (ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’) · also in an indirect question, ’what’ (ὅττι ἑ κήδοι ’what was troubling him’) · also conj. ’that, because’, introducing a clause (ὅττι μιν ὣς ὑπέδεκτο ’that he had received him so’)
ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ) · also agreeing with ἔλαιον: ’liquid (oil)’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕλῃ: ὕλη — forest, woodland; fem. dat. sg.
ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’above’
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ ·
